records.title: A three-state posterior cone and reconstruction on finite-mean Galton-Watson trees
records.scope: Observed iid finite-mean Galton-Watson trees, ferromagnetic q=3, 0<lambda<1; reconstruction iff d*lambda^2>1, including nonreconstruction at equality. Four-state conclusion is credited to the prior cone.
records.boundaries: No new claim for the earlier regular/Poisson core; no all-offspring q>=5 or antiferromagnetic completion.
records.verification: internal mathematical review; exact checks described in release

records.title: Exact power tails and moment growth for a contractive nonlinear SGD model
records.scope: The explicit scalar nonlinear Gaussian regression model, |theta|<=1 and 0.99<=eta<=1.01; unique stationary law, strictly positive exact tail exponent 1<alpha<2, and stated moment limits.
records.boundaries: Concrete-model target; established renewal theory and moment antecedents are credited. Not arbitrary nonlinear networks.
records.verification: internal mathematical review; exact checks described in release

records.title: Calibration along gradient descent in Gaussian tanh random-feature classifiers
records.scope: The stated Gaussian fixed-feature logistic-teacher model; every fixed finite time and the specified all-positive-stopping-time ratio/step regimes.
records.boundaries: No general feature-learning or all-ratio all-time theorem. Time zero is calibrated; signed overconfidence is average and scale-specific.
records.verification: internal mathematical review; exact checks described in release
